scheme_name: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: Power Subsidy
other_conditions: Unit must have started production on or after 1st April 2022
Units may be in the private sector, co‑operative sector, joint sector or owned/managed by the State Government
Project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution
Unit must hold a Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate and Eligibility Certificate issued by the Director of Textiles
benefits_summary: Provides a power subsidy ranging from ₹50 lakh to ₹2 crore per annum for a period of five years.
documents_required: Eligibility Certificate issued by the Director of Textiles
